title: Rational quadrilaterals and tetrahedra -- the involutions of Kummer, Heegner and Regge
summary: This paper is devoted to questions concerning rational quadrilaterals and rational tetrahedra. In both cases there is a finite group which acts on the set. In the case of rational quadrilaterals it was discovered by Kurt Heegner; in the second case there are two variants, one again due to Heegner the other a consequence of an involution introduced by Tullio Regge. These allow one to construct a number of solutions to the appropriate diophantine equation from given ones. The original question was posed by Kummer.
